HEDGEHOG: proposed elderly salt-and-pepper/gray-brown quills, cream face/chest, white eyebrows and warm brown eyes echoing human form, rounded ears/muzzle, natural two paws/two feet, no human beard or robe. Both depictions are ONE person in alternative forms, never two independent cast members.

Tarin’s relationship to published hedgehog Elder is unresolved; keep this distinct requirement, do not copy or silently alias published Elder.
